title: Authentic
style: phonk, melodic trap, 165 BPM, detuned synth arps, atmospheric minor pads, distorted 808 slides, punchy kick, crisp snare cracks, live drum kit, post-punk bassline, tape saturation, stereo widener, spring reverb, male chant vocals, Spanish ad-libs, defiant urgency, nocturnal swagger
lyrics:
[Intro]
Broki inspires me…
A legend like Yowoki…
NC Argis… Pinol…
[Verse 1]
Broki inspires me like a legend, just like Yowoki
If the cops come, I’ll hit you on the lowkey
Everything I do is authentic, no copies
If you’re a snake, don’t hop in my ride with me
I’m flying high, piloteo, nights without sleep
I know the magic that I carry deep inside
At the end I’m still human, there’s love in what I do
Don’t talk to me about flow, we all heard what you dropped today
Nah nah nah, I won’t let ambition blind my way
With harmony I’ll take you to another dimension
[Chorus]
People don’t confess anymore, that’s just how it is
Different rhythms, when I step in I dominate
My swag is marking, they listen and say “oh my God”
The world got rotten, now it’s all gone
We’ll change it tomorrow but nobody tried
In my beginnings they laughed more than they supported
Blue and white Pinol, I give thanks to God
If you wanna save yourself, you gotta do it now
[Verse 2]
I keep going for the ones who talk, for the ones who insist
For the promises I made to my mother
As long as I’m alive nobody can contradict this
I want my voice to be a union in other countries
I’m not a graduate, singer is what I chose to be
My insomnia predicts it, I learned from the eclipse
Don’t wish for millions if you’re gonna die in the end
[Chorus]
People don’t confess anymore, that’s just how it is
Different rhythms, when I step in I dominate
My swag is marking, they listen and say “oh my God”
The world got rotten, now it’s all gone
We’ll change it tomorrow but nobody tried
In my beginnings they laughed more than they supported
Blue and white Pinol, I give thanks to God
If you wanna save yourself, you gotta do it now
[Outro]
Authentic what I do… no copies…
Blue and white Pinol… thanks to God…
If you wanna save yourself… you gotta do it now…
NC Argis… melodic trap with soul…
